entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Translate Enumerable.Concat over byte arrays #39345
    Backlog
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: GetOrdinal throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException and GetValues rejects a short array, unlike the IDataRecord contract #39343

Closed

  • Exeption when querying json, that happens only on Azure SQL with compatibility level 170 #38615
    10.0.11
  • SQL Server: custom model-level HiLo sequence causes repeated DropSequence migrations and pending model changes #39324
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/11.0] Use live version of System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs #39350
    area-infrastructure
  • Make parameter collection projections untranslatable so they get client eval #39349
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39348
  • [release/8.0]: Bump SQLitePCLRaw.core from 2.1.13 to 2.1.14 #39347
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/8.0]: Bump SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlite3 from 2.1.13 to 2.1.14 #39346
    area-infrastructure
  • Follow the IDataRecord contract in SqliteDataReader.GetOrdinal and GetValues #39344
    community-contribution
  • Fix misleading exception messages when obtaining DbSet with entity type name (#31565) #39342
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/11.0] Don't derive NULLIF nullability from its first argument #39315
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/11.0] Preserve null results from primitive collection element converters #39288
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/11.0] Preserve inherited complex-property column prefixes in TPC mappings #39270
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/11.0] Fix FromSql queries with JSON-mapped complex properties #39295
    Servicing-approved
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39279
  • [release/9.0] Update branding to 9.0.23 #39340
    branding-update
  • [release/8.0] Update branding to 8.0.34 #39341
    branding-update
  • Preserve model-level SQL Server HiLo sequences in snapshots #39325

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Fix Azure SQL JSON_VALUE RETURNING over nested OPENJSON projections #39299
    Servicing-consider
  • Cosmos datetime fixed width #39131
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #39257
